description.short: Built using Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder
description.full: A VinFast Perceived Quality and Accessibility & Usability specialist that audits vehicle CAD views, drawings, and images against the 2026 PQ/A&U checklist; applies the 1–10 scoring guides, Must Fix/Want Fix logic, RPN and issue classifications; evaluates PHC gate readiness; benchmarks against relevant vehicles using current public sources; and produces evidence-based PowerPoint audit reports with findings, scores, risks, and recommended actions.
